items.title: How AI Agents Use Tools The Harness Explained
items.description: How do AI agents actually use tools like web search? The model can't magically go online, it can only predict text. So when it wants to search, it outputs a structured message that looks like code, saying it wants to use the search tool. The code running the model (the agent harness) sees that, runs the tool, gets the result, and hands it back to the model to process. That handoff (model decides, harness executes) is the whole way AI agents work at scale. #techwithtim #ai #aiengineer

zh.title: AI 代理如何使用工具：机制解析
zh.description: AI 代理实际上是如何使用像网络搜索这样的工具的呢？模型不能神奇地联网，它只能预测文本。因此，当它想要搜索时，它会输出一个看起来像代码的结构化消息，表示它想要使用搜索工具。运行模型的代码（代理机制）看到这一点，运行工具，获取结果，并将其交回给模型处理。这种交接（模型决定，机制执行）就是 AI 代理大规模工作的全部方式。#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer
